title: Vertical phase separation induced highly efficient pseudo-bilayer photoanodes for organic photoelectrochemical cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1993-1997
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01731E, Communication
Jaehyeong Kim, Soonyong Lee, Yeonjeong Lee, Tack Ho Lee, Jin Young Kim, Han Young Woo
Vertical phase separation in the photoactive layer enables durable, high-performance organic photoelectrodes by addressing the inherent limitations of organic photoelectrochemical cells.
